question: Can the exact 4D continuous native GRU/history-MLP architectures imitate a strong observation-only teacher on genuine upstream MIT CartPole factual demonstrations, and can a simpler learned conventional observation model do so reliably?
null: Even after equal supervised demonstration budgets, learnt actors fail to approach a strong factual controller or generalize to unseen public development reset seeds. This assay cannot prove factual reward-only learning or superior causal-history use.

design.sensor: four factual continuous real CartPole observations with prior observed action/reward only; NO hidden physics or tokenization
design.teacher: fixed P18 handcoded_state_control using only current public theta and angular velocity; supervisory labels ARE teacher-derived and are not reward-only
design.eval_policy: greedy with NO teacher labels provided to actor, no optimizer steps

thresholds.original_handcoded_controller: observational upper reference; do not require impossible +10 above 200

design.integrity: all per-action observed outcomes, demonstration sources, train val & eval seed lists, training and eval weights hashes, no original P18 retuning, original full platform regression required
